name: Wraith
fantasy: A chained, horned spirit that never touches the ground. It rends souls, drains foes on a tether, steps through shadow and brings down the night.

directions.name: Render
directions.desc: The claws: Spectral Rend, quick strikes and cruel crits.

directions.name: Shadow
directions.desc: The tether and the mist: Soul Siphon and Shadow Step.

directions.name: Night
directions.desc: What comes out of the dark: Haunting Grasp, Phantom Assault and Eternal Night.

skills.name: Spectral Rend
skills.desc: Lunge at the foe ahead and rake it twice with spectral claws for 90% weapon damage each. Souls torn out fly back and heal you.

skills.name: Soul Siphon
skills.desc: Tether a foe, stunning it for 2.5 s while you drain about 180% weapon damage, healing a third. It is slowed after. You can fight on meanwhile.

skills.name: Shadow Step
skills.desc: Turn to mist and re-form at the cursor, clawing around you for 130% weapon damage and a 0.7 s stun. Blows pass through you briefly, and your old shade bursts.

skills.name: Haunting Grasp
skills.desc: Spectral hands burst up around the cursor, seizing every foe within 3.5 m for 110% weapon damage, pulling them in and holding them for 2.5 s.

skills.name: Phantom Assault
skills.desc: Split into 3 phantoms that streak through foes ahead in a fan for 120% weapon damage each, then strike with your claws.

skills.name: Eternal Night
skills.desc: Bring down the night within 9 m: a scream deals 150% weapon damage, hurls foes back and freezes them with fear for 2.5 s. The dark feeds on them while you hang untouchable, then you slam for 200%. +40% damage for 12 s.

skills.name: Death Mark
skills.desc: Mark the foe nearest the pointer. After 3 s it takes half the damage you dealt it meanwhile (at least 150% weapon damage), and you heal.

skills.name: Banshee Wail
skills.desc: Scream: everything within 6 m takes 60% weapon damage, is frozen in terror for 1.2 s, then slowed by half for 2 s.

skills.name: Reaping Crescent
skills.desc: Sweep a crescent of soul-fire 5 m ahead for 170% weapon damage. Each foe hit heals you 2% of your life.

rites.name: Keen Claws
rites.text: Spectral Rend deals {dmg:rend}% more damage.

rites.name: Grim Focus
rites.text: +{dex} dexterity.

rites.name: Soul Harvest
rites.text: Each soul Spectral Rend tears out heals {rend_heal}% more of your life.

rites.name: Deathly Haste
rites.text: +{ias}% attack speed.

rites.name: Cruelty
rites.text: +{crit}% critical chance.

rites.name: Executioner
rites.text: Critical hits deal {crit_dmg}% more damage.

rites.name: Harvest Moon
rites.text: Spectral Rend's claws tear all the way round you.

rites.name: Hungry Tether
rites.text: Soul Siphon drains {dmg:siphon}% more.

rites.name: Ethereal Mind
rites.text: +{mana_pct}% maximum mana.

rites.name: Long Grip
rites.text: Soul Siphon holds {siphon_dur} s longer.

rites.name: Slipstream
rites.text: Shadow Step recharges {cd:step}% faster and strikes {dmg:step}% harder.

rites.name: Hollow Hunger
rites.text: Soul Siphon costs {cost:siphon}% less mana and recharges {cd:siphon}% faster.

rites.name: Spirit Form
rites.text: +{res}% to all resistances.

rites.name: Lingering Mist
rites.text: After Shadow Step you stay mist {veil} s longer, and its strike stuns {step_stun} s longer.

rites.name: Unlife
rites.text: +{life_pct}% maximum life.

rites.name: Grave Chill
rites.text: +{armor_pct}% defense.

rites.name: Legion
rites.text: Phantom Assault and Haunting Grasp strike {dmg:phantom}% harder.

rites.name: Spectral Ward
rites.text: +{res}% to all resistances.

rites.name: Eternal
rites.text: Eternal Night's power lasts {buff_dur} s longer and Haunting Grasp holds {grasp_hold} s longer.

rites.name: Soul Siphon
rites.text: +{ls}% life steal.

rites.name: Fourth Rider
rites.text: Phantom Assault sends a fourth phantom, and Eternal Night deals {dmg:night}% more damage.

rites.name: Marked Soul
rites.text: Death Mark tears out {mark_pct}% more and comes back {cd:r_deathmark}% sooner.

rites.name: Keening
rites.text: Banshee Wail reaches {wail_r}% further and terrifies {wail_t} s longer.

rites.name: Harvest of Souls
rites.text: Reaping Crescent hits {dmg:r_reap}% harder and heals {reap_heal}% more for each it reaps.

rites.name: Reaper
rites.text: Your hits on foes under {below}% life deal +{more}% damage.

rites.name: Soul Feast
rites.text: Each kill heals you {pct}% of your life.

rites.name: Dread
rites.text: Every hit chills its foe with dread.
